mapper.select: -- 先获取用户岗位，再关联其他数据，避免重复连接 WITH user_posts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT mpr.level_id,mpr.post_id FROM org_member_user_rel mur INNER JOIN org_member_post_rel mpr ON mur.member_id = mpr.member_id WHERE mur.user_id = #{userId} ) SELECT l.id AS level_id, l.level_name, pds.post_id, p.post_name, pds.data_id, pds.data_scope, pds.data_flag FROM user_posts LEFT JOIN org_post_data_scope pds ON user_posts.post_id = pds.post_id LEFT JOIN org_level l ON user_posts.level_id = l.id LEFT JOIN org_post p ON user_posts.post_id = p.id

-- 先获取用户岗位，再关联其他数据，避免重复连接 WITH user_posts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT mpr.level_id,mpr.post_id FROM org_member_user_rel mur INNER JOIN org_member_post_rel mpr ON mur.member_id = mpr.member_id WHERE mur.user_id = #{userId} ) SELECT l.id AS level_id, l.level_name, user_posts.post_id, p.post_name FROM user_posts LEFT JOIN org_level l ON user_posts.level_id = l.id LEFT JOIN org_post p ON user_posts.post_id = p.id

SELECT om.* FROM org_member_user_rel omur LEFT JOIN org_member om ON omur.member_id = om.id WHERE omur.user_id IN
#{user}

SELECT om.id, om.member_name, omur.user_id AS user_id FROM org_member_user_rel omur LEFT JOIN org_member om ON omur.member_id = om.id WHERE om.id IN
#{id}
SELECT om.id AS member_id, om.member_name, omur.user_id AS user_id FROM org_member_user_rel omur LEFT JOIN org_member om ON omur.member_id = om.id WHERE omur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT om.id, om.member_name, omur.user_id AS user_id FROM org_member om LEFT JOIN org_member_user_rel omur ON omur.member_id = om.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = omur.user_id WHERE om.member_name = #{memberName} LIMIT 1
SELECT om.id, om.member_name, omur.user_id AS user_id FROM org_member om LEFT JOIN org_member_user_rel omur ON omur.member_id = om.id WHERE omur.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT om.member_name AS target_member_name, omur.user_id AS target_user_id, fp.level_id AS target_level_id, l.level_name AS target_level_name FROM org_member_user_rel omur INNER JOIN org_member om ON om.id = omur.member_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT level_id FROM org_member_post_rel WHERE member_id = om.id ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 ) fp ON true LEFT JOIN org_level l ON l.id = fp.level_id WHERE omur.user_id = #{targetUserId} LIMIT 1

SELECT omur.user_id, om.id, om.member_name FROM sys_account a INNER JOIN org_level_post_rel olpr ON olpr.level_id = r.scope_org_id AND olpr.lead_flag = #{leadFlag} LEFT JOIN org_member_post_rel ompr ON ompr.post_id = olpr.post_id LEFT JOIN org_member om ON ompr.member_id = om.id LEFT JOIN org_member_user_rel omur ON ompr.member_id = omur.member_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY om.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
